edges.reason: CATXTimeLock constructor forwards the token argument into the TokenTimelock constructor parameter
CATXTimeLock constructor forwards the beneficiary argument into the TokenTimelock constructor parameter
CATXTimeLock constructor forwards the releaseTime argument into the TokenTimelock constructor parameter
constructor token parameter is stored into the _token state variable
constructor beneficiary parameter is stored into the _beneficiary state variable
constructor releaseTime parameter is stored into the _releaseTime state variable
block.timestamp comparison gates the TokenTimelock constructor execution
block.timestamp comparison against _releaseTime gates whether release can execute
_releaseTime is read inside release to validate the release window
_token is the target contract of the safeTransfer external call
_beneficiary is the recipient argument of the safeTransfer external call
local amount derived from balanceOf is passed into the safeTransfer external call
safeTransfer performs an external call to the token contract before release state is fully settled, allowing a malicious token to re-enter release
